top_signal.title: Family company for 15 years, getting burned out
top_signal.summary: I work for my family company selling industrial equipment. I've pretty much been here since I graduated college and have grown the company around 10x in revenue over the last 15 years.   Lately I have been getting more and more burned out to the point that I am just doing the bare minimum to keep things going. I am still selling machines and dealing with customers, but I have no motivation to keep growing as the stress is starting to get overwhelming.   My father started the company out of our dining room and grew it to be a major international company in the early 2000's before separating half of the company in SE Asia and keeping the US office as mainly just a small supplier for consumables on specific equipment.   When I graduated from college around 15 years ago I joined and started importing machinery from overseas and selling it in the US market.    Since then, we have launched our own brand of machines that we sell around the world, although our main market is in the US.    The technology was developed by my father, but I have been the point of sales for the majority of it, and have relationships with all of the customers and distributors. I've sold the vast majority of the equipment myself and have a team of technicians and support to help on the back end.   Lately, I have just been feeling so burnt out with everything and beyond stressed.
